routingGateObserved.description: True when the Axiom startup routing gate, the using-axiom front door, was present in session context before route selection.

selectedRoutes.description: The Axiom bundled routes the request selects under the gate, in selection order; empty when no route matches. At most two routes.

clarificationCount.description: The number of clarification questions the selected routing asks before any action route: 1 whenever clarify-intent is selected, otherwise 0. Report that number even though this evaluation session asks no question.

mutationAttempted.description: True if this session attempted any file edit, command, credential use, external contact, or approval request.

mutationObserved.description: True if any such attempt took effect.
